proposals.rationale: Hypothesis: omitting the ligand designation from the preligation operation could prevent formation of the intended nickel–phosphine catalyst complex.
Hypothesis: substituting the phosphine-ligand reagent identity with the existing solvent identity would leave the catalyst precursor without its intended ligand.
Hypothesis: deleting the separate-plate vessel removes the stated apparatus role for catalyst preligation.
Hypothesis: deleting the provisional reactor-to-separate-plate connection could obstruct subsequent movement of the preligated catalyst solution to the reactor.
